useCases: Projects and their pi sessions in a sidebar. Every open session runs its own pi, so switching never stops work.
Slash commands: pi's extension commands, prompt templates and skills, plus `/compact`, `/tree`, `/fork`, `/clone`, `/model`, `/new`, `/name`
